title: Duckling wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='18' ry='12' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  <!-- wing left -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='70' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#F5C400' transform='rotate(-15 30 70)'/>
  <!-- wing right -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='70' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#F5C400' transform='rotate(15 70 70)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='20' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <!-- cheek left -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='50' r='5' fill='#FFAA55'/>
  <!-- cheek right -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='5' fill='#FFAA55'/>
  <!-- eye left -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='41' r='4' fill='#3A2A00'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  <!-- eye right -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='41' r='4' fill='#3A2A00'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  <!-- beak top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- beak bottom -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#E67300'/>
  <!-- party hat cone -->
  <polygon points='50,8 36,30 64,30' fill='#FF4F9A'/>
  <!-- hat stripe 1 -->
  <polygon points='46,16 42,22 58,22 54,16' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- hat stripe 2 -->
  <polygon points='42,24 38,30 62,30 58,24' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- pompom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='5' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x='36' y='28' width='28' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- feet left -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- feet right -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#FF8C00'/>
</svg>
